create.name: Cynthia James
create.bio:
Cynthia James is an American transformation coach, speaker, author and singer whose work centres on helping people, and women in particular, find their voice and live with a clear sense of purpose. She trained to master's level twice, in consciousness studies at the Holmes Institute (the Science of Mind school) and in spiritual psychology at the University of Santa Monica, and she often weaves music, movement and other creative arts into her teaching. She says her own path began with moving beyond a violent childhood.

She works one to one and with groups through what she calls emotional integration, built on three steps of inquiry, introspection and integration, and she runs self-paced online courses on purpose and self-expression, free online meditation evenings and a community on her own platform. She has written several books, among them What Will Set You Free, I Choose Me, Does My Voice Matter? and The Kingdom of Magic and Mystery, records meditations and songs, and hosts the Women Awakening podcast. She has taught at spiritual centres and conferences in the United States and abroad, spent six years co-teaching a science and spirituality course at the Colorado School of Mines, and leads pilgrimages to Egypt, Peru and France.

books.title: The Kingdom of Magic and Mystery: 7 Castles of Revelation, Inspiration and Creativity to Activate Joy and Freedom
books.author: Cynthia James
books.description: Her 2025 book, built around seven imagined castles, each tied to a theme such as art, dance, water or animals, with stories and exercises for creativity and inner freedom.

books.title: I Choose Me: The Art of Being a Phenomenally Successful Woman at Home and at Work
books.author: Cynthia James
books.description: A book for women on putting their own needs and inner life at the centre so that work and home life can both flourish.

courses.title: Finding Your Voice
courses.description: A self-paced online course on self-expression and purpose, looking at values, fears that hold people back and stepping into visibility. It comes with meditations, a copy of her book Does My Voice Matter? and access to an online community.

courses.title: Reveal Your Purpose: Self Discovery Introductory Course
courses.description: A three-module self-guided course of teaching videos and worksheets for clarifying a sense of calling, with support through her online community group.

courses.title: Revealing Your Purpose Intensive
courses.description: A longer weekly course in five modules that goes further into purpose work, with her e-book Revealing Your Extraordinary Essence, a workbook and four guided meditations, taken over a 90-day access period.

courses.title: Coaching and Emotional Integration Sessions
courses.description: One-to-one, couples and group sessions, in person or on Zoom, built on her three steps of inquiry, introspection and integration, plus full-day intensives for speakers and workshop leaders.

free_resources.title: Reflection & Reset Gathering
free_resources.description: A free hour online, held every few months, with guided meditation and quiet reflection in a small community setting. The next one is on 17 December 2026 at 6 pm Mountain Time.
